steps.caption: keydown добавя клавиша в множество, keyup го маха.

steps.caption: Цикълът чете множеството всеки кадър и движи героя.
steps.code:
<canvas id=c width=400 height=160></canvas>
<script>
const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
const keys = new Set();
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => keys.add(e.code));
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.code));
let x = 40, last = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  if (keys.has("ArrowRight")) x += 150 * dt;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 160);
  ctx.fillRect(x, 60, 30, 30);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

steps.caption: event.code е физически клавиш: KeyA работи и на кирилица.
steps.code:
<canvas id=c width=400 height=160></canvas>
<script>
const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
const keys = new Set();
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => keys.add(e.code));
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.code));
let x = 40, last = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.1);
  last = now;
  if (keys.has("ArrowRight")) x += 150 * dt;
  if (keys.has("KeyA")) x -= 150 * dt;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 160);
  ctx.fillRect(x, 60, 30, 30);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
